notes.title: Five years on, some minor fixes
notes.content:
Changelist
- Reduced enemy Hitpoints by 30%, scaling to 50% at max level
- Reduced amount of monster kills required to clear maps
- Totems now spawn an item when completed
- Boreal Hunter ability cooldowns reduced
- Smasher ability cooldowns reduced
- Reduced amount of kills required to complete Monster log slots
- Increased force of Berserker's Battle Cry

I've moved on to other projects, but wanted to give this one some love. Have a great day.

notes.title: Some good news and bad news!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today, I have some good news and some bad news. First of all, the release of Outrealm will be delayed by one week, to February 7th. Issues relating to Steam uploads have taken some time to sort out, which unfortunately means that I can’t bring it to you guys just yet. I can only say that I’m terribly sorry to have to announce this delay, and am working my hardest behind the scenes to ensure a smooth release.

But, some good news! Two spotlight videos have been released, showcasing various elements of the game. The realm spotlight shows off one of my favourite areas, the icy Realm of Frozen Peaks. And the character spotlight gives you a little insight into all of the characters, their abilities and playstyles. Both can be watched on Youtube with the links below.

Spotlight: Realm of Frozen Peaks
Spotlight: The Characters

Once again, I’m sorry for the delays and am doing my best to bring things forward. Within the next week I’ll be releasing part one of the Outrealm development post-mortem, so look forward to that!

notes.title: Outrealm on Steam!
notes.content:
After a long and arduous road, Outrealm has finally arrived on Steam! With development in its final stages, the focus is on polish and eliminating bugs. The game is set to launch in just over two weeks, on February 1st!

Thinking about picking up the game? Add it to your wishlist and tell your friends! If you want to chat with others about the game, the best place is on the official Outrealm  Discord . The Discord is the place to be if you have questions about the game!

I’ll be posting more updates and news in the coming weeks. Things you can expect over the next fortnight:

- Character and Realm spotlight videos.
- Development Post-mortem.
- More information about the game.

So, stay tuned, and I'll hopefully see you round shortly!

     - Rainbow Street Studios
